description: This source file defines a PDO database abstraction class for the Opencart system, encapsulating database connection, query execution, escaping, and transaction-related functionalities.

classes.name: PDO
classes.description: A class that wraps around PHP's native PDO to provide a simplified API for database operations within Opencart, including connection handling, query execution, and utility methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a database connection using provided options, throws exception if required parameters are missing or connection fails.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with prepared statements, returning result data objects or boolean, and handling errors.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Creates a named parameter placeholder for safe SQL usage and stores the actual value for later binding.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last data modification query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last auto-increment ID generated by an insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the database connection is currently active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
